column1: # No credential-shaped value is copied here: a cell of the form `@label` stands
# for the line of that label in known-secrets.tsv, which is generated.
# One row per PATH REGEX declared in a [[allowlists]] block of .gitleaks.toml.
# .ci/gitleaks/test-allowlists.py reads that file as the registry and fails on
# any declared path this table does not exercise, so a new allowlist cannot be
# added without stating, here, exactly how wide it is.
#   path-regex   the entry's own regex, verbatim, which is what the coverage
#                check matches on - copy it, do not retype it
#   file-path    a concrete path that regex must match
#   silenced     a line that MUST NOT be reported at that path
#   still-fires  a line at the SAME path that MUST still be reported, or `-`
#                for a blanket entry that has no such line. A `-` is a
#                declaration that the entry excuses every rule at that path.

column3: Pull web content/data into files         →  scrape (local, zero-API: crawl/map/render/PDF; --attach renders in your real logged-in Brave)
